question.knowledge_point: Solving for Three Coefficients in a Linear Combination
question.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -10 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -10 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ 3{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{x}_{2} \\ 0 \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{3} \\ 5{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -10 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3} \\ 5{x}_{3} \\ 3{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -10 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=-5 \\ 5{x}_{3}=-10 \\ 3{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=1\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & -10 \\ 3 & -1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & -10 \\ 3 & -1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & -10 \\ 0 & 2 & -5 & 16\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & ↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 2 & -5 & 16 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & -2.5 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=\frac{1}{5}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & 2 & -5 \\ 0 & 1 & -2.5 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=-5 \\ {x}_{2}-2.5\,{x}_{3}=8 \\ {x}_{3}=-2.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=-2.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get 

$$
{x}_{2}-2.5(-2)=8\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=8-5=3.
$$

Finally,  substituting ${x}_{2}=3$ and ${x}_{3}=-2$  into the first equation, we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}-(3)+2(-2)=-5\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=2.
$$

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=2$, ${x}_{2}=3$, and ${x}_{3}=-2,$ which means 

$$
2{a}_{1}+3{a}_{2}-2{a}_{3}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=2+3-2=3.
$$
